note: Medicine Bow NF campground at 10,500 ft in the Snowy Range beside Brooklyn Lake (opens late, snow-dependent). Sites sit in an open meadow loop above the lake: the west sites look through a band of spruce to the main lake, the south sites across open meadow to its southern arm. Non-motorized boats only, carry-down access. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 231844: confirmed $20, 19 sites with 5 pull-throughs, no hookups, vault toilets, hand-pump water (Jul-Sep), mix of reservable (11-19) and FCFS (02-10), 14-day limit. Season (manual 07-04 to 10-15) matches the FS page. FS posts a 22-ft camping-trailer limit (22 ft passes per AWH 2026-10-20). Waterfront: imagery puts every RV pad 60-100 m from the shore, behind trees on the west -> recommend lakefront -> lakeview.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (recommend lakefront -> lakeview): measured from the catalog's per-site points on Esri imagery, the nearest RV pads are 04 (41.37358,-106.24846) and 05 (41.37334,-106.24843), ~60-70 m from the main lake's east shore through a continuous band of spruce; 07 (41.37296,-106.24807) ~70 m through the same trees; 08 and 09 (41.3728,-106.2477) ~100 m across open meadow from the lake's southern arm; 11 (41.37316,-106.24648) ~130 m. No site is within ~50 m over open ground. The stored evidence ('~50m ... across open unobstructed alpine ground') is not borne out. Contrary claims: the rec.gov catalog tags 04, 05, 07, 08, 09 and 11 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' and the FS page says 'each site has a view of the lake' (supports the view value). 05 is typed for pickup campers/vans/tents only.

CRITERIA (informational, keep): FS page Restrictions: 'Camping trailer has a maximum length of 22 feet.' A 22-ft limit does not fail (AWH 2026-10-20); the catalog permits RV on 14 sites with driveways to 71 ft (13 pull-through 71 ft, 02 pull-through 65 ft) and 5 pull-throughs are described for 'longer or trailered setups'.
Missing phone: empty -> 307-745-2300 (Laramie Ranger District, rec.gov facility phone).

Season: the manual 07-04 to 10-15 matches the FS page; rec.gov's 2026 first-come rate season ran Jun 16 - Jul 9 and Sep 13 - Oct 4, so walk-up camping opened earlier in 2026 than the FS dates. Not overwritten (manual).
